Same consequence as above. ... use `faraday.request :authorization, :basic, @user, @password`. On 2.12.2 this sent `Authorization: Basic dTpw`, byte-for-byte what 1.10.4 sends today.
FD2.reasons: Validation checks only the header on a 200 and a 401 case; it omits a fresh-process run with numeric/colon/hash credentials, successful/failed refresh, owner/no-DOI denial and unsafe-metadata controls.
